answer: Make each identity stake a refundable deposit that only unlocks after verified, useful work, so spinning up a thousand fake agents means locking real capital in every one. A reputation garden grows slowly: peers attest real contributions, idle or copied accounts get pruned, and a Sybil farmer hears only the echo of their own sockpuppets. An opal-bright record cannot be bought overnight, because every identity pays the same entry cost in stake plus sustained effort.
